catalogue_governance_contract: Document each component family with source ownership, public API/variants, states, content and accessibility behavior, domain constraints and actual callers.

Catalogue definitions, source references, rendered states, tested interactions, review decisions and release adoption are distinct evidence stages. Never call a screen verified from an import, symbol count or raster mockup.
Retain five independent C01 identities and domain vocabularies. Shared generic behavior is reusable without making every app use the same palette, type scale or operational meaning.
Target package organization uses five app-owned folders: admin, marketplace, seller, sales_associate and delivery. These are future locations, not current folders or changes made by this asset task.
Reuse and extend documented primitives rather than creating equivalent wrappers; preserve valid domain-specific record/chart/map content inside canonical composition.
Each state example is independent: ready, busy, disabled, error, empty, restricted, focus, selection and recovery require appropriate actual contracts. No outcome follows from a catalogue specimen.
Static source tracing includes definition, resolved import/caller and state branch. Regex counts are candidates only; record ambiguity, aliases, hidden exports and mixed inline UI.
Verify screen adoption with rendered light/dark states, relevant widths/large text, meaningful interactions, semantics, keyboard/touch/reduced motion and error/recovery boundaries.
Use deterministic synthetic fixtures and safe preview mounts; do not access production accounts, private records or real financial/auth/delivery mutations for catalogue work.
Track exceptions and migration/deprecation decisions with exact caller scope and evidence. Remove a legacy API only after callers are migrated and relevant checks pass.
Preserve auth/session/owner guards, localization sources, navigation, privacy and server-authoritative outcomes during later presentation migration; do not treat them as duplicate UI.
C28 is asset documentation only: no runtime package folders, widgets, screen migration, render tests, adoption pass/completion percentages, assigned reviewer or release decision is created.

manual_source_traces.state_scope: Search field in product catalogue composition, not every product editor/list state.

source_mapping_method: Textual source inventory with lightweight comment/string screening; not Dart AST, resolved imports, route coverage, distinct screen counts, adoption percentages or rendered verification. Five separately reviewed call-site traces are SOURCE_TRACED only.
implementation_status: Design assets/docs only. No app/package runtime, pubspec, navigation or backend changed by this task.
limits: Raster catalogue proposals; static source candidates and manually traced uses are not rendered verification, screen adoption, tested interaction or pixel-exact token certification.
